security_audit.summary: All 21 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown syntax, Chinese technical text, a fixed sibling reference, a generic metadata key, or normal task polling. No prompt injection or obfuscated payload was found. Cloud processing can disclose user media, and unquoted URL substitution can create shell interpretation risk.

remediation.issue: Cloud commands can submit user media to an external processing service.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before cloud processing and identify which media URL, callback, and destination will be transmitted.

remediation.issue: Command examples substitute user-provided URLs without an explicit shell-escaping requirement.
remediation.suggestion: Require robust shell argument quoting or direct argument-array execution for every user-provided URL, path, identifier, and callback value.

content.value_statement: Audio analysis and conversion often require different tools and precise parameters. This skill selects MediaKit workflows for metadata, voice activity, separation, and transcoding.
actual_capabilities: Detect voice segment start and end times in supported audio or video.
Inspect codec, duration, bitrate, channels, sample rate, container, and file size.
Separate vocals and background audio into independent output files.
Transcode audio to MP3, M4A, or OGG with supported encoding settings.
Configure loudness, bitrate, sample rate, channels, metadata, and output storage.
Poll asynchronous cloud tasks until final results are available.
limitations: MediaKit CLI and the shared MediaKit skill must be installed.
Most operations require cloud credentials, network access, and accessible media locations.
Local mode is documented only for audio metadata inspection.
Cloud workflows can return temporary links unless persistent VOD or TOS storage is configured.

use_cases.title: Prepare Podcast Edits
use_cases.description: Find spoken segments and separate voices from background sound before editing.

use_cases.title: Audit Media Libraries
use_cases.description: Inspect technical metadata and identify files that need format normalization.

use_cases.title: Deliver Compatible Audio
use_cases.description: Convert audio codecs, containers, bitrate, channels, and loudness for target platforms.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Audio Metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the audio at [audio URL]. Report its format, codec, duration, bitrate, channels, sample rate, and size.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a basic technical inspection.

prompt_templates.title: Detect Spoken Segments
prompt_templates.prompt: Detect voice activity in [audio or video URL]. Return each spoken segment with start and end times.
prompt_templates.scenario: Locate speech for review or editing.

prompt_templates.title: Separate Voice and Background
prompt_templates.prompt: Separate the voice and background audio from [media URL]. Use [output format] and report both output locations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create independent stems from a recording.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Audio Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Transcode [audio URL] to [container] using [bitrate], [sample rate], [channels], and [loudness target]. Preserve only [metadata tags].

output_examples.input: Inspect the metadata for a WAV recording.
Find speech in an interview recording.
Separate vocals from a music track.
output_examples.output: The cloud task completed and returned separate voice and background audio locations.

best_practices: Confirm the operation, input location, and output requirements before execution.
Use only user-provided callback, queue, token, and storage values.
Review the current CLI schema before using advanced or changing parameters.
anti_patterns: Do not invent media URLs, credentials, callback details, queue identifiers, or storage destinations.
Do not send sensitive media to cloud processing without explicit user approval.
Do not use this skill for editing, subtitle generation, transcription, or video enhancement.

faq.question: Which audio operations are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports metadata inspection, voice activity detection, vocal separation, and audio transcoding.

faq.question: Can it process video files?
faq.answer: Voice detection and separation can accept supported video inputs. Other video tasks require a video or editing skill.

faq.question: Does it work without cloud access?
faq.answer: Only metadata inspection includes a documented local mode. Other operations use MediaKit cloud services.

faq.question: Which output formats are available?
faq.answer: Transcoding supports MP3, M4A, and OGG containers. Vocal separation supports AAC, MP3, WAV, M4A, and FLAC.

faq.question: Are cloud results permanent?
faq.answer: Cloud workflows can return temporary links. Configure VOD or TOS storage when persistent results are required.

faq.question: What must be installed?
faq.answer: Install MediaKit CLI and the shared MediaKit skill. Cloud operations also require valid credentials and network access.
